no_text: Render every lanyard, ID badge, name patch, cap front, hi-vis panel, hard-hat sticker, chest print, monitor, whiteboard, clipboard sheet, mug and carton as a CLEAN BLANK SURFACE. Absolutely no text, no letters, no Korean hangul, no numbers, no logos, no wordmarks anywhere in the image. Keep the shape, size, colour and position of the badge, patch, screen and label, but leave them empty.

materials.treatment: real skin with visible pores, fine lines, stubble, uneven tone and whatever blemishes and marks the reference already carries; hair with flyaway strands and honest sheen; fabric with weave, creases, seams and wash-fade; workwear with dust, ink marks and worn cuffs; hands with knuckle lines, short nails and working callus

focus: sharp on the eyes when the face is in frame and on the point of contact when it is not, natural lens depth of field, no fake background blur, no cut-out edges

still.B: the subject holds still and holds the look; nothing else in the frame moves and nobody else enters it
still.H: everything held — the shape stays put, no motion, nobody crossing the bright opening behind

modes.name: formal environmental portrait
modes.direction: The considered portrait of one person in the place they actually work. Long lens, formal distance, the workplace present but held back behind them.
modes.licence: restage the background, choose a cleaner standing position and a better working distance; wardrobe colour may be resolved only where the reference is ambiguous. The person's face, identity, apparent age, body, skin tone, ethnicity and gender are LOCKED and carry through from the reference unchanged.
modes.light: one large soft key from a window or a bounced source at 45 degrees, a soft fall across the far cheek, the workplace behind sitting two stops down

cam.por: lens dead level with the subject's eyeline, standing well back across the room so the workplace compresses behind them, half-length, 105mm feel
cam.work: level with the eyeline, three-quarter from the side of the task, subject half-length with the work held in the near frame, 85mm feel
cam.team: level with the group's average eyeline, stepped back so the row reads as one band, waist-up, 85mm feel
cam.hand: dropped below the eyeline to the level of the hands, standing back and reaching in with the lens, hands and tool tight in frame, 100mm feel
